# @k8o/arte-odyssey

> k8o's React UI library (React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4) with semantic design
> tokens, dark mode, AI chat components, and official generative UI adapters
> (json-render & OpenUI) that let an LLM generate, validate, and render on-brand UIs
> from these components.

These docs are served from <https://arte-odyssey.k8o.me>.
Start with the Design Guide, then follow the reference most relevant to the task.

## Guide

- [Design Guide](https://arte-odyssey.k8o.me/design.md): setup, i18n (default Japanese, switching to English), design direction, aesthetic guidelines, component usage principles, anti-patterns, implementation principles.

## References

- [Components](https://arte-odyssey.k8o.me/ja/components): full component list, import paths, props, and i18n — component wording comes from a dictionary that defaults to Japanese; `@k8o/arte-odyssey/i18n` exports `ja` / `en` / the `Messages` type for `<ArteOdysseyProvider messages={...}>` (per-component wording props win over the dictionary).
- [AI chat](https://arte-odyssey.k8o.me/ja/ai-chat): AI chat components from `@k8o/arte-odyssey/ai` (Conversation / Message / PromptInput / Reasoning / Suggestion / ToolInvocation), streaming Markdown `Response` from `@k8o/arte-odyssey/ai/response` (optional peer `streamdown`), and `mapMessageParts` from `@k8o/arte-odyssey/ai-sdk` to render AI SDK `UIMessage.parts` (optional peer `ai`).
- [Generative UI](https://arte-odyssey.k8o.me/ja/generative-ui): use json-render / OpenUI to make an LLM generate UIs — `catalog.prompt()` (server-safe), `<JsonRenderUI spec={spec} />` (client), `validateGeneratedSpec()` (validate/repair LLM output), `satisfies ArteSpec` (typed specs), and `@k8o/arte-odyssey/openui/prompt`.
- [Typography](https://arte-odyssey.k8o.me/design.md): type scale and usage.
- [Color](https://arte-odyssey.k8o.me/design.md): semantic token system and dark mode.
- [Spacing & layout](https://arte-odyssey.k8o.me/design.md): spacing scale and layout patterns.
- [Interaction](https://arte-odyssey.k8o.me/design.md): motion and interaction guidelines.
- [Hooks](https://arte-odyssey.k8o.me/ja/hooks): custom hooks.
- [Helpers & types](https://arte-odyssey.k8o.me/ja/helpers): helper functions and types.
